The subject of the search was found at the address submitted, but a more recent record shows a different address for the individual.   If a customer intentionally provides an old address and a new one is located, this result will occur, but it also results from a customer providing a current “home” address and the IDology search locating newer real estate, like a second/vacation home or an investment property.

This indicates that the State located does not match the state input as part of the address.  This ID Note is a very specialized response and is only available if configured by IDology.

The submitted street name does not match the located data.  This can be due to a typo in the input or the located data.  This note will always be accompanied by the resultcode.address.does.not.match ID Note.
